recommendation: Keep the no-change audit for FHIR-53203. Track FHIR-54843 / PR #4107, or its successor, for the remaining bodySite/bodyStructure harmonization and audit that issue separately once it is applied.
issue_request: FHIR-53203 requested that OO resources with bodySite adopt bodyStructure as CodeableReference(BodyStructure), deprecating Observation.bodySite/search where applicable and using the SNOMED CT Body Structures example binding for codeable support.
initial_application: Jira comments pointed to HL7/fhir PR #3793 and follow-up PR #3859. The merged history updates Observation, ObservationDefinition, and ServiceRequest bodyStructure definitions/search parameters, deprecates Observation.bodySite, and removes ServiceRequest.bodySite, while leaving Specimen unchanged because its bodySite datatype had already been changed by FHIR-33072.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms Observation, ObservationDefinition, ServiceRequest, and Specimen are active resources. Specimen.collection.bodySite remains named bodySite but is already CodeableReference(BodyStructure) with the body-site value set. Later FHIR-55603 rejected a harmonization pattern as needing more discussion, and FHIR-54843/open PR #4107 now cover Specimen.collection.bodyStructure rename, cardinality, and broader bodyStructure cleanup outside this applied/published seed scope.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit records that current active source already reflects FHIR-53203 for Observation, ObservationDefinition, and ServiceRequest, and that making a partial Specimen rename/cardinality edit under FHIR-53203 would duplicate or pre-apply later FHIR-54843 work.
